Inspiring Figures & Digital Presence

A

Chapter Overview

Selamat datang di Chapter 1. Pada bab ini, kalian belajar menggunakan descriptive text untuk mendeskripsikan tokoh inspiratif sekaligus membangun digital presence yang baik, aman, dan bermanfaat.

Dalam kehidupan sehari-hari, terutama di wilayah kepulauan dan pesisir, kita sering bertemu orang-orang yang menginspirasi. Ada siswa yang membantu orang tua mengelola rumput laut tetapi tetap rajin belajar. Ada pemuda yang membuat konten edukasi tentang kebersihan pantai. Ada guru yang tetap mengajar meskipun jaringan internet terbatas. Ada nelayan yang menjaga laut dari sampah dan praktik merusak lingkungan. Ada kreator konten muda yang memperkenalkan budaya lokal dengan cara positif.

Melalui bab ini, kalian akan belajar mendeskripsikan orang seperti itu dalam Bahasa Inggris. Kalian juga akan belajar membangun digital presence atau kehadiran digital yang baik, sopan, aman, dan bermanfaat.

Big Question: How can we describe inspiring people and present ourselves positively online?
Bagaimana kita dapat mendeskripsikan orang-orang inspiratif dan menampilkan diri secara positif di dunia digital?

Mindful Starter: Look, Think, Connect

Perhatikan tiga situasi berikut. Bayangkan situasinya terjadi di sekitar sekolah atau pulau tempat tinggal kalian.

Situasi Belajar

Gunakan gambar ini untuk mengamati hubungan antara pembelajaran Bahasa Inggris, tokoh inspiratif, dan perilaku positif di media sosial.

Instruksi: Diskusikan siapa tokoh yang menginspirasi kalian, apa sifatnya, dan bagaimana media sosial bisa dipakai untuk pesan yang baik.

Situation 1

A Young Island Student Sharing Beach-Cleaning Content

A student from a small island posts a short video about cleaning plastic waste near the beach. The video is simple, but the message is powerful. Many friends become interested in joining the activity.

Seorang siswa pulau mengunggah video pendek tentang membersihkan sampah plastik di pantai. Videonya sederhana, tetapi pesannya kuat.

Situation 2

A Technology Innovator Helping Remote Communities

A young innovator creates an offline learning application for students in remote areas. The application helps students study even when the internet connection is weak.

Seorang inovator muda membuat aplikasi belajar offline untuk siswa di daerah terpencil.

Situation 3

A Positive Content Creator Educating Teenagers

A content creator makes short videos about study tips, English vocabulary, and polite online behavior. The creator avoids drama, hoaxes, and cyberbullying.

Seorang kreator konten membuat video pendek tentang tips belajar dan perilaku sopan di media sosial.

Reflection Questions

  1. Who inspires you the most? Siapa yang paling menginspirasimu?
  2. What makes a person inspiring? Apa yang membuat seseorang inspiratif?
  3. What kind of digital presence should students build? Kehadiran digital seperti apa yang sebaiknya dibangun siswa?
  4. What should students avoid posting online? Apa yang sebaiknya tidak diunggah siswa di media sosial?
  5. How can social media be used for positive learning? Bagaimana media sosial dapat digunakan untuk belajar secara positif?
D

What Is Descriptive Text?

Descriptive text digunakan untuk menggambarkan orang, tempat, benda, hewan, atau sesuatu secara jelas agar pembaca dapat membayangkan dan memahaminya.

Definition

Descriptive text is a text that describes a person, place, object, animal, or thing clearly so readers can imagine and understand it.

Teks deskriptif adalah teks yang menggambarkan seseorang, tempat, benda, hewan, atau sesuatu secara jelas.

Social Function

The social function of descriptive text is to describe a specific person, place, or thing in detail.

Dalam bab ini, descriptive text digunakan untuk mendeskripsikan tokoh inspiratif dan digital presence yang positif.

When Do We Use Descriptive Text?

SituationExample
Describing an inspiring personShe is a brave environmental activist.
Writing a profileHe is a young innovator from a small island.
Making an infographicShe creates useful educational content.
Introducing an idolI admire him because he is humble and hardworking.
Building a positive digital profileI am a creative student who loves learning English.

Structure of Descriptive Text

1. Identification

Identification introduces the person, place, or thing being described.

Contoh: Maya Lestari is a young environmental activist from a coastal village.

Bagian ini menjawab: Who is the person? What is the person known for? Where does the person come from? Why is the person important?

2. Description

Description gives details about the person’s appearance, personality, activities, achievements, values, and impact.

Contoh: She is brave, caring, and deeply concerned about the ocean.

PartFunctionExample
TitleGives the topicMaya Lestari: A Young Ocean Protector
IdentificationIntroduces the personMaya Lestari is a young environmental activist.
Description 1Describes backgroundShe lives in a coastal village.
Description 2Describes personalityShe is brave, caring, and responsible.
Description 3Describes actions/impactShe invites students to clean the beach.
ClosingGives final impressionShe inspires many young people to love the ocean.
E

Grammar Lab 1: Simple Present Tense

Simple present tense digunakan untuk menggambarkan fakta, kebiasaan, sifat seseorang, kebenaran umum, dan perilaku digital positif.

Function

  1. describing facts — menggambarkan fakta;
  2. describing habits — menggambarkan kebiasaan;
  3. describing personality — menggambarkan sifat;
  4. describing general truths — menggambarkan kebenaran umum;
  5. describing positive digital behavior — menggambarkan perilaku digital positif.

Basic Patterns

Subject + Verb 1 / Verb-s/es
She creates educational videos.

Subject + is/am/are + adjective/noun phrase
She is brave, creative, and humble.

SubjectVerbExampleMeaning
I/You/We/TheycreateThey create educational videos.Mereka membuat video edukatif.
He/She/ItcreatesShe creates educational videos.Dia membuat video edukatif.
SubjectTo beComplementExampleMeaning
IamcreativeI am creative.Saya kreatif.
He/SheisresponsibleShe is responsible.Dia bertanggung jawab.
Theyarehardworking studentsThey are hardworking students.Mereka siswa yang pekerja keras.

Verb -s / -es Rule

Base VerbHe/She/It FormExampleMeaning
makemakesHe makes useful content.Dia membuat konten bermanfaat.
teachteachesShe teaches English online.Dia mengajar Bahasa Inggris secara daring.
watchwatchesHe watches educational videos.Dia menonton video edukatif.
studystudiesShe studies every evening.Dia belajar setiap malam.
carrycarriesHe carries books to school.Dia membawa buku ke sekolah.
inspireinspiresShe inspires many students.Dia menginspirasi banyak siswa.

Correct and Incorrect Examples

Incorrect SentenceCorrect SentenceExplanation

He are creative.He is creative.Gunakan is untuk he.
They is responsible.They are responsible.Gunakan are untuk they.
Maya help her community.Maya helps her community.Tambahkan -s karena Maya satu orang.
Raka create offline apps.Raka creates offline apps.Tambahkan -s karena Raka satu orang.

Model Texts

Bacalah tiga contoh teks deskriptif berikut. Perhatikan struktur, simple present tense, adjective phrases, dan digital presence.

Model Text 1: Technology Innovator

Raka Pratama: A Young Island Innovator

Tokoh fiktif ini dibuat agar dekat dengan kehidupan siswa kepulauan: teknologi sederhana, akses internet terbatas, dan semangat belajar mandiri.

Raka Pratama: A Young Island Innovator

Identification

Raka Pratama is a young technology innovator from a small island in Indonesia. He is known for his simple offline learning application for students with limited internet access.

Description

Raka is creative, hardworking, and highly motivated. He understands that many students in remote islands cannot always use the internet for learning. Because of that, he creates a simple application that stores English vocabulary, reading texts, and short quizzes offline.

Raka does not come from a big city, but he has a big dream. He studies technology by reading books, watching downloaded tutorials, and practicing every day. He is also careful with digital information. He checks his sources before sharing anything online.

Many students admire Raka because he uses technology to solve a real problem. He shows that young people from islands can be innovative and helpful. His digital presence is positive because he shares learning tips, simple coding ideas, and motivational messages.

Raka inspires students to use technology wisely. He proves that creativity can grow anywhere, even in a small island with limited internet.

Identification: “Raka Pratama is a young technology innovator from a small island in Indonesia.”
Personality: creative, hardworking, highly motivated.
Action: creates a simple offline learning application.
Digital presence: shares learning tips and motivational messages.

Model Text 2: Environmental Hero

Maya Lestari: A Young Ocean Protector

Identification

Maya Lestari is a young environmental activist from a coastal village. She is admired because she cares deeply about the ocean and marine life.

Description

Maya is brave, caring, and environmentally aware. Every weekend, she invites her friends to clean the beach near their village. She collects plastic bottles, food wrappers, and other waste that can harm fish, turtles, and coral reefs.

Maya also uses social media to educate young people. She posts short videos about reducing plastic waste, bringing reusable bottles, and keeping the beach clean. Her captions are polite, clear, and positive. She never uses rude words or blames people harshly.

One thing that makes Maya inspiring is her consistency. She does not only talk about the environment; she takes real action. She believes that small actions can create big changes when many people work together.

Maya has a positive digital presence because she uses her account to spread useful messages. She inspires many students to protect the ocean and respect nature.

Identification: “Maya Lestari is a young environmental activist from a coastal village.”
Personality: brave, caring, environmentally aware.
Activity: invites friends to clean the beach.
Digital presence: posts short videos and polite captions.

Model Text 3: Positive Content Creator

Dina Rahma: A Positive Learning Content Creator

Identification

Dina Rahma is a young content creator who makes educational videos for teenagers. She is known for her short English lessons, study tips, and positive online messages.

Description

Dina is confident, friendly, and digitally responsible. She creates simple videos that help students learn English vocabulary, pronunciation, and useful expressions. Her videos are short, clear, and easy to understand.

Dina’s digital presence is positive because she uses social media to help others learn. She writes respectful captions and answers comments politely. She does not spread hoaxes, join online fights, or make fun of other people.

Dina also reminds her followers to protect their privacy. She tells students not to share personal information such as home addresses, passwords, or private family problems online.

Many teenagers admire Dina because she makes learning feel fun and possible. She shows that social media can be used for education, motivation, and kindness.

Identification: “Dina Rahma is a young content creator…”
Personality: confident, friendly, digitally responsible.
Content: English vocabulary, pronunciation, useful expressions.
Positive value: education, motivation, kindness.
H

Reading Comprehension

Bacalah teks berikut dengan teliti, lalu jawab pertanyaannya.

Arman, a Student with a Positive Digital Mission

Arman is a Grade X student from a small island school. He is not a famous celebrity, but many students respect him. He is known for his positive posts about learning, ocean care, and school activities.

Arman is creative, responsible, and friendly. After school, he often helps his parents and studies English at night. When the internet connection is good, he downloads learning videos and saves them for offline study. He also shares short vocabulary posts with his classmates.

Arman uses social media carefully. He does not post private information or rude comments. He checks information before sharing it, especially news about weather, boat schedules, or school activities. He believes that false information can confuse people.

One of Arman’s best posts is about keeping the school area clean. He writes a simple caption: “Small actions matter. Let’s keep our school and beach clean.” Many students like the post because the message is positive and easy to follow.

Arman inspires his friends because he uses social media for good purposes. He shows that students do not need to be famous to make a positive impact.

Reading Questions

  1. Who is Arman?
  2. Why do many students respect Arman?
  3. Mention three personal traits of Arman.
  4. What does Arman do when the internet connection is good?
  5. What kind of content does Arman share with his classmates?
  6. Why does Arman check information before sharing it?
  7. What is the caption of Arman’s best post?
  8. Why do many students like Arman’s post?
  9. What does the phrase “positive impact” mean in the text?
  10. What can you learn from Arman’s digital behavior?

Listening Script: My Inspiring Figure

While-Listening Task 1: Gap Filling

  1. Lina wants to talk about her __________ figure.
  2. Sari is a young content creator from a __________ village.
  3. Sari creates videos about clean beaches and healthy __________ habits.
  4. She is creative, responsible, and __________.
  5. She never shares __________ information.
  6. Sari reminds students to protect their __________ online.
  7. Lina wants to create __________ content like Sari.

While-Listening Task 2: Sequencing

Urutkan informasi berikut sesuai teks listening.

A. Lina says she wants to create positive content.
B. Sari creates videos about clean beaches.
C. Lina introduces her inspiring figure.
D. Sari reminds students to protect privacy online.
E. Lina says Sari is creative, responsible, and kind.

Speaking Practice

Gunakan ekspresi sederhana, sopan, dan jelas. Fokus pada tokoh inspiratif dan digital presence.

Activity 1: Pair Talk

Bekerjalah berpasangan. Tanyakan dan jawablah: Who inspires you? Why do you admire him/her? What is his/her best trait? What does he/she do? Does he/she have a positive digital presence?

Activity 2: Mini Interview

Wawancarai temanmu tentang tokoh idola. Catat nama tokoh, sifat, kegiatan, dan pesan digital positifnya.

Dialogue Example

Alya: Who inspires you, Rian?

Rian: I admire my older cousin. His name is Fadil.

Alya: What does he do?

Rian: He creates short videos about learning English and protecting the beach.

Alya: That sounds interesting. What is his personality like?

Rian: He is creative, friendly, and responsible.

Alya: Why do you think his digital presence is positive?

Rian: Because he shares useful content. He does not post rude comments or false information.

Alya: What do you want to learn from him?

Rian: I want to learn his confidence and discipline.

Student Draft and Revised Version

Student Draft

My inspiring figure is Maya. She is environmental activist from coastal village. She care about beach. She always clean plastic waste with her friends. She is very inspiration. She use social media for good message. I like her because she brave.

Revised Version

My inspiring figure is Maya. She is an environmental activist from a coastal village. She cares about the beach and marine life. She always cleans plastic waste with her friends. She is very inspiring, brave, and responsible. She uses social media to share positive messages about protecting the ocean. I admire her because she takes real action for the environment.

ProblemExplanation
“She is environmental activist”Harus menggunakan article: “an environmental activist.”
“She care”Untuk she, gunakan “cares.”
“She always clean”Untuk she, gunakan “cleans.”
“very inspiration”Salah bentuk kata. Gunakan “very inspiring.”
“She use”Untuk she, gunakan “uses.”
“she brave”Gunakan to be: “she is brave.”

Digital Presence & Personal Branding Corner

Media sosial dapat digunakan untuk belajar, berkarya, menghargai orang lain, dan memperkenalkan nilai positif dari lingkungan kepulauan.

What Is Digital Presence?

Digital presence is how people see you online through your posts, comments, profile, photos, videos, and interactions.

Digital presence adalah cara orang melihat dirimu di dunia digital.

What Is Personal Branding?

Personal branding is the image or impression you build about yourself. Sebagai siswa, personal branding berarti menunjukkan diri sebagai pelajar yang respectful, responsible, creative, honest, positive, safe online, and willing to learn.

Why Should Students Care?

  1. Unggahan digital bisa dilihat banyak orang.
  2. Komentar yang buruk bisa menyakiti orang lain.
  3. Informasi palsu bisa membingungkan masyarakat.
  4. Profil digital dapat menunjukkan karakter.
  5. Media sosial bisa menjadi tempat belajar dan berkarya.
Good ContentArti
learning progressperkembangan belajar
school projectsproyek sekolah
positive captionscaption positif
environmental campaignskampanye lingkungan
local culture appreciationapresiasi budaya lokal
creative workskarya kreatif
useful informationinformasi bermanfaat
polite opinionspendapat yang sopan
AvoidArti
cyberbullyingperundungan digital
rude commentskomentar kasar

oversharing private informationterlalu banyak membagikan informasi pribadi
embarrassing other peoplemempermalukan orang lain
spreading unverified newsmenyebarkan berita yang belum diperiksa

Negative CommentYour video is ugly.Videomu jelek.
Respectful CommentYour message is good. Maybe you can make the sound clearer next time.Pesanmu bagus. Mungkin lain kali suaranya bisa dibuat lebih jelas.
Privacy MistakeThis is my home address and my password.Ini alamat rumah dan kata sandi saya.

Common Mistakes in Descriptive Text

Perhatikan kesalahan umum berikut agar tulisanmu lebih jelas dan benar.

TypeIncorrectCorrectExplanation
Forgetting -s/-esShe inspire students.She inspires students.She membutuhkan verb-s.
Forgetting -s/-esHe make videos.He makes videos.He membutuhkan verb-s.
Wrong word formShe is very inspiration.She is very inspiring.Gunakan adjective “inspiring”.
Wrong word formHe is innovation.He is innovative.Gunakan adjective “innovative”.
Wrong to beHe are creative.He is creative.He menggunakan is.
Wrong to beThey is helpful.They are helpful.They menggunakan are.
Wrong adjective orderShe is a student creative.She is a creative student.Adjective biasanya sebelum noun.
Too longShe is kind and she is brave and she helps students and she posts videos and she is good.She is kind and brave. She helps students by posting educational videos.Pisahkan ide agar jelas.
Too generalgood / nice / greatresponsible / caring / helpful / inspiringGunakan adjective yang lebih spesifik.

Interactive Quiz: Multiple Choice A–E

Pilih jawaban terbaik. Soal disusun dari level LOTS, MOTS, hingga HOTS, dengan narasi seperti soal cerita.

1LOTS

Nina menulis teks Bahasa Inggris tentang seorang guru di sekolah kepulauan. Dalam teksnya, Nina menjelaskan nama guru tersebut, sifatnya yang sabar, cara mengajarnya yang kreatif, dan alasan siswa mengaguminya. Tujuan utama teks Nina adalah….

2LOTS

Rafi menulis kalimat berikut pada awal teksnya: “Dina Rahma is a young content creator who makes educational videos for teenagers.” Kalimat tersebut termasuk bagian….

3LOTS

Seorang siswa selalu memeriksa informasi sebelum membagikannya ke grup kelas. Ia tidak langsung percaya pada berita tentang jadwal kapal atau pengumuman sekolah sebelum memastikan sumbernya. Kata sifat yang paling tepat untuk menggambarkan siswa tersebut adalah….

4LOTS

Dalam kalimat “Maya is environmentally aware,” arti frasa “environmentally aware” adalah….

5LOTS

Kalimat yang benar untuk mendeskripsikan kebiasaan seorang tokoh perempuan adalah….

6LOTS

Tina ingin menulis bio media sosial yang positif sebagai siswa. Pilihan bio terbaik adalah….

7MOTS

Read the text: “Arman is a Grade X student from a small island school. He shares short vocabulary posts with his classmates. He checks information before sharing it, especially news about weather and boat schedules.” What does Arman share with his classmates?

8MOTS

Sari adalah seorang kreator konten positif. Ia membuat video tentang kebersihan pantai. Kalimat Bahasa Inggris yang paling tepat adalah….

9MOTS

Perhatikan kalimat: “He is a highly motivated student from a coastal village.” Adjective phrase dalam kalimat tersebut adalah….

10MOTS

Seorang siswa ingin memperbaiki kalimat “He is good.” agar lebih jelas dalam descriptive text. Pilihan terbaik adalah….

11MOTS

Read the text: “Lina never posts her home address online. She also avoids sharing private family problems on public accounts.” What can we infer about Lina?

12MOTS

Read the paragraph: “Maya is a young environmental activist from a coastal village. She is brave, caring, and responsible. She invites her friends to clean the beach every weekend.” Which sentence is the identification?

13MOTS

Read the sentence: “Dina is trustworthy because she checks information before sharing it.” The word “trustworthy” means….

14MOTS

Riko membaca berita di media sosial bahwa sekolah akan libur selama satu minggu. Ia belum melihat pengumuman resmi dari sekolah. Tindakan paling bertanggung jawab adalah….

15HOTS

Seorang siswa membuat caption untuk kampanye kebersihan pantai. Caption mana yang paling positif dan sopan?

16HOTS

A student writes: “She is very inspiration and she use social media for teach student.” Which revision is the best?

17HOTS

Maya memiliki akun media sosial. Ia mengunggah video singkat tentang cara mengurangi sampah plastik, menulis caption sopan, dan mengajak teman-temannya membawa botol minum sendiri. Ia juga tidak membalas komentar negatif dengan kata-kata kasar. Kesimpulan terbaik tentang Maya adalah….

18HOTS

Pilih paragraf yang paling sesuai sebagai descriptive text tentang tokoh inspiratif.

19HOTS

Fajar wants to build a positive digital profile. He writes three possible posts: 1) “This is my home address and my daily schedule.” 2) “I am learning English and designing a poster about clean beaches.” 3) “My friend failed the test. Look at this photo.” Which post is the safest and most positive?

20HOTS

A student from a coastal school wants to describe an inspiring local figure. The figure helps students learn, reminds people not to throw plastic waste into the sea, and shares polite educational messages online. Which title is the most suitable?

21HOTS

A Grade X student wants to introduce himself in a positive way for a digital portfolio. Which statement shows the best personal branding?

22HOTS

Read the sentence: “She is deeply concerned about the ocean, so she creates educational videos about plastic waste.” The sentence shows that….

23HOTS

A student writes: “He is nice. He is good. He is great. He is very good.” What is the main weakness of the writing?

24HOTS

A school group wants to make an online campaign about clean beaches. They want the message to be polite, clear, and motivating. Which message is the best?

25HOTS

A student wants to create an infographic about a real environmental activist. He finds information from an unknown account with no source. What should he do before using the information?

Teacher’s Key – Hide This Section If Used for Students

🔒 Open Teacher’s Key

Reading Comprehension Key

  1. Arman is a Grade X student from a small island school.
  2. Because he shares positive posts about learning, ocean care, and school activities.
  3. Creative, responsible, and friendly.
  4. He downloads learning videos and saves them for offline study.
  5. He shares short vocabulary posts.
  6. Because false information can confuse people.
  7. “Small actions matter. Let’s keep our school and beach clean.”
  8. Because the message is positive and easy to follow.
  9. A good effect or useful influence.
  10. Students should use social media carefully, positively, and responsibly.

Listening Key

Gap Filling: 1 inspiring, 2 coastal, 3 study, 4 kind, 5 false, 6 privacy, 7 positive.

Sequencing: C - B - E - D - A

Vocabulary Builder Key

Activity 1: 1 B, 2 A, 3 D, 4 C, 5 E.

Activity 2: 1 caring, 2 creative, 3 responsible, 4 respectful, 5 brave.

Activity 3: 1 A, 2 B, 3 A.

Simple Present Practice Key

1 inspires, 2 creates, 3 clean, 4 cares, 5 makes.

Quiz Answer Key

1 B, 2 C, 3 B, 4 B, 5 B, 6 B, 7 B, 8 B, 9 C, 10 B, 11 B, 12 C, 13 C, 14 C, 15 C, 16 B, 17 B, 18 B, 19 B, 20 C, 21 B, 22 A, 23 C, 24 B, 25 C.

You do not need to be famous to inspire others. You can start with small positive actions: learning seriously, speaking politely, protecting your environment, and using social media responsibly.

You can be an inspiring student from your island.
